newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Plane equipment maker to list on Bucharest bourse.
newsitem.headline: Plane equipment maker to list on Bucharest bourse.

text.p: The Bucharest bourse said on Thursday that Aeroteh, a Bucharest-based airplane equipment maker, would start trading on Friday on the market's second tier, taking total listings on the bourse to 48.
Aeroteh's share capital is 17.4 billion lei, in shares with a nominal value of 25,000 lei each, a stock exchange statement said.
The State Ownership Fund is Aeroteh's majority stockholder with a 68.6 percent stake and individual shareholders acquired 31.38 percent in a mass selloff. Company managers have the rest.
Aeroteh last year had a net profit of 532.7 million lei, up from 98.7 million in 1995.
Eight companies trade on the stock exchanges first tier.

Listing requirements for companies on the bourse's first tier are more rigorous than for those on the second tier. First tier firms are required to have made profits in the two years prior to listing.
